badge: Job of the Week · Smart Lock

scenes.title: Still using keys?
scenes.body: Keys only. No codes, no app, no idea if it's locked.

scenes.title: Prep the door edge
scenes.body: Clean up the bore and latch pocket so the new bolt sits flush.

scenes.title: Connect the keypad cable
scenes.body: The outside keypad's cable routes through to the inside unit.

scenes.title: Mount the inside unit
scenes.body: Tip: keep the code label off camera, it has your lock's codes.

scenes.title: Cover on, batteries in
scenes.body: Then connect it to Wi-Fi in the Schlage Home app.

scenes.title: Schlage smart lock: done
scenes.body: Unlock with a code, a key or your phone, from anywhere.
